<ins>Supplementing Injury and Rejoining Sinew Pill (補損續筋丸)</ins> Treats injuries from falls, blows, and falling, with broken bones, severed sinews, and torn flesh, and unceasing pain. Dang gui (當歸, washed in wine, five qian), chuanxiong (川芎), white peony (白芍, stir-fried), cooked rehmannia (熟地, each three qian), broad saussurea (廣木香), moutan bark (丹皮), frankincense (乳香, oil removed clean), myrrh (沒藥, oil removed clean, each five qian), drynaria (骨碎補), pyrite (自然銅), safflower (紅花), melon-seed dragon's blood (瓜兒血竭, each three qian), cinnabar (硃砂, five qian), clove (丁香, one qian), ginseng (人參, one liang), tiger bone (虎骨, parched with suet oil, two liang), ancient copper coin (古銅錢, three)
Grind all together into fine powder, make into pills with refined honey; take three qian per dose, dissolved in light yellow wine (淡黃酒) and boy's urine. <ins>Supplementing Injury and Rejoining Bone Immortal Elixir (補損接骨仙丹)</ins> Treats the same conditions as above.
